not_support.claim: That the Azure adapter works, or that any provider call was made
not_support.why: No provider was contacted by this branch. Every fact above is a documentation or reference-client reading recorded in a frozen research cache.

not_support.claim: That ADO-003's review, vote, policy and check criteria are falsifiable today
not_support.why: TA-038's repair amends the promise rather than writing the fixtures. Those criteria are stated and carry no fixture; q-019 tracks the work, and the units say so in their own validation surfaces.
The union rests on five compared leads of 115 or more discovered. Twenty-six is a lower bound with an unknown remainder; q-017 tracks the queued second pass.

withdrawn.why: The confirmation review tested the shipped schema across all nine providers and found the repository_binding conditional already rejects a null project for azure_devops and bitbucket_data_center. The proposed change would also have invalidated the shipped gitlab, forgejo and gitea positives. Only the second Azure negative it allowed as fixture coverage was added.

withdrawn.finding: The union's claim that command_target already requires both review revision refs for the compare command
withdrawn.why: False as written: the conditional declares both properties and places neither in a required list. AZ-12 rests on the FGI-004 promise alone, and its record says so.

withdrawn.finding: The union's claim that pipeline_disabled is a reason-code enum member
withdrawn.why: It is in neither closed enum. The corrected finding in AZ-14 is stronger and not Azure-specific: every non-empty declaration in the corpus carries at least one off-enum code.
